modalities.evidence: Data were acquired at 7T with 0.6 mm isotropic resolution

output.population: Sixteen healthy adults (10 female, 5 male, 1 non-binary); ages 21–49
output.summary: High-resolution 7T fMRI of human visual cortex during an orientation-discrimination task under different image segmentation conditions, measuring BOLD responses across cortical depth to probe surround suppression in primary visual cortex.
